# AyuSwar AI

> Sovereign ambient clinical voice scribe and 108 emergency triage for Indian healthcare.

AyuSwar AI is an ambient clinical voice intelligence, acoustic signal reasoning, and health informatics platform designed for Primary Health Centers (PHCs), Community Health Centers (CHCs), and 108 emergency networks across India. It supports colloquial comprehension across 7 Indic languages (Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali, and English), translating doctor-patient conversations into structured ABDM FHIR R4 medical notes and vernacular audio prescriptions.

## Platform Modules

- [Doctor Clinical Console](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/doctor): Ambient OPD clinical voice scribe generating structured SOAP notes and ABDM FHIR records with physician review.
- [Spoken Audio-Rx Studio](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/audio-rx): Vernacular spoken prescription generator with karaoke timing to combat patient medication errors.
- [Sanjivani 108 Emergency Dispatch](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/sanjivani): Acuity triage protocol with conservative clinical floor, CPR audio metronome, and telemetry.
- [Acoustic Biomarker Lab](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/biomarkers): Non-diagnostic screening for respiratory acoustics (wheeze, stridor, crackles).
- [Prescription Scanner](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/scan): Optical recognition with Jan Aushadhi (PMBJP) generic drug cost-saving alternatives.
- [Patient Health Portal](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/patient): Vernacular symptom check-in and multi-lingual voice records for rural citizens.

## Technical Documentation & Standards

- [Deep-Tech Architecture Blueprint](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/technology): Monograph covering acoustic DSP, Gnani Indic voice pipeline, and ABDM M3 sovereign bridge.
- [Automated Verification Benchmarks](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/benchmarks): 74 passing test specs verifying FHIR schemas, triage floors, and dialect crosswalks.
- [Full LLM Technical Reference](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete system prompts, ontology tables, and integration schemas.
- [XML Sitemap](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Search engine indexing manifest.

## Privacy & Safety Guardrails

- [DPDP Act 2023 Ephemeral RAM](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/privacy): Ephemeral in-memory audio processing within Indian boundaries; zero persistent audio storage.
- [Clinical Safety Sentinel](https://ayuswar-ai.vercel.app/safety): Deterministic rule floors that prevent AI from downgrading clinical emergencies or dosing medications autonomously.
